name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.InstCtx.tests_wf
typeText:
∀ {k : Nat} {g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance} {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.InstCtx k g m →
    And (LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.TESTS))
      (And
        (LE.le.{0}
          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.TESTS) 1)
            (m (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.TESTS)))
          (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP))
        (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RecsIn m (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.TESTS) DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN
          (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP)))

source.code:
theorem InstCtx.tests_wf {k : ℕ} {g : GInstance} {m : Mem} (hm : InstCtx k g m) :
    IN ≤ m TESTS ∧ m TESTS + 1 + m (m TESTS) ≤ m HP ∧ RecsIn m (m TESTS) IN (m HP) := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hm.arr_tests
  refine ⟨h1, h2, fun q hq => ?_⟩
  rw [List.mem_iff_getElem] at hq
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hq
  rw [arrAt_getElem]
  rw [h3] at hi
  exact ⟨(h4 i hi).1, (h4 i hi).2.1⟩
